title: Ministerial Statement on Fifth Set of COVID-19 Measures
what_it_is: Ministerial Statement on Fifth Set of COVID-19 Measures

sections.label: COVID-19 support budget packages
sections.summary: From February to June, close to $100 billion in COVID-19 support was committed over four Budget packages for people and businesses.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: From February to June, we committed close to $100 billion in COVID-19 support, over four Budget packages, to support our people and businesses.

sections.label: Further COVID-19 support measures broadcast
sections.summary: On 17 August, further COVID-19 support measures were laid out via a television broadcast to give businesses and workers clarity.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: To ensure that we gave businesses and workers clarity on the Government’s continued support, on 17 August, I laid out further COVID-19 support measures via a television broadcast.

sections.label: Funding and Parliament accountability measures
sections.summary: The measures are fully funded by re-allocation with no expenditure increase, no further Past Reserves draw, and require Supplementary Estimates and Bill in October.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: As I stated in my 17 August statement, the measures will be fully funded by re-allocation, with no further increase in the Government’s overall expenditure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: We do not plan to draw further on Past Reserves for this set of measures.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: To ensure accountability to Parliament, we will present a Third Supplementary Estimates and Third Supplementary Supply Bill in the next Parliament Sitting in October.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: The Supplementary Estimates will be considered in the Committee of Supply and the Bill will go through the First, Second and Third readings in Parliament.

sections.label: Amount compared to Fortitude Budget
sections.summary: It is $5.1 billion compared to what was indicated in the Revised Estimates in the Fortitude Budget.

sentences.speaker: Mr Liang Eng Hwa (Bukit Panjang)
sentences.text: If I remember correctly, it is $5.1 billion compared to what was indicated in the Revised Estimates in the Fortitude Budget.

sections.label: Limited scope for reallocation
sections.summary: For this financial year, there is still some, albeit very limited, scope to consider reallocation across the various Heads of Expenditure.

sentences.speaker: Mr Heng Swee Keat
sentences.text: For this financial year, there is still some scope – albeit very limited – for us to consider reallocation across the various Heads of Expenditure.
